title_candidates: Grok 4.5 arrives with a free trial for demanding work
summary: SpaceXAI's Grok 4.5 targets coding, agent tasks, and office work, with access through Grok Build, Cursor, and the API.

primary_source.title: Introducing Grok 4.5
primary_source.author: SpaceXAI
key_facts: Grok 4.5 is intended for coding, agent tasks, knowledge work, and office documents.
It is available in Grok Build, Cursor, and the SpaceXAI API.
Launch pricing is $2 per million input tokens and $6 per million output tokens.
The release was not available in the European Union at launch.

prerequisites: A Grok Build or Cursor account
A small task with a result you can inspect

steps.instruction: Open Grok Build or Cursor and select Grok 4.5.
Choose one small, reversible task with a known expected result.
Ask the model to complete the task and show how it checked its work.
Inspect formulas, links, and changed files yourself.
Compare its time and corrections with your normal model.

risk_flags: Provider benchmark claims are not treated as independent results; access varies by region.
